messages:
tara_cs: Heads-up — running a QBR dry-run for Meridian on Thu 9am PT. Need slides + final action owners by Wed EOD. Who can own slide deck ops?
ben_csm: I can take onboarding health slide. Quick status: onboarding is amber — 2 missing integrations, one delayed setup. Will add notes.
omar_solutions: I'll own the renewal risk matrix and ask list. Need last 30d usage and spike details from infra. @lina_eng can you paste numbers?
lina_eng: Pushed CSV with token counts + p95 latency to Drive: https://drive.redwood/meridian-qbr/stats.csv — added short comments in column D.
ben_csm: Thx @lina_eng. I'll convert health items into 3 remediation asks for exec slide.
elaine_exec: I can join the exec prep. Wed 3pm works for me. Suggest we rehearse the "ask" slide (3 bullets): adoption ask, expansion ask, risk mitigation.
jordan_success: For enablement, proposing a 20-min customer-facing demo recap + 10-min exec Q&A. Need a single enablement slide with outcomes & next steps. I can draft.
tara_cs: Nice. Also capture feedback themes from last NPS: stability, latency, onboarding docs. Jordan — can you include a one-liner per theme?
jordan_success: Yep, will do.
omar_solutions: Also propose a fallback talking point if infra numbers look worse: we show model routing + dedicated capacity option and estimated cost tradeoffs.
elaine_exec: Good. Add a quick cost delta table — 2 rows: current hosted vs dedicated reserve.
ben_csm: Quick ask: who will own slide upload + version control? Recommend we use the shared deck and tag slides with initials in the footer.
tara_cs: @ben_csm you own the deck upload. Please tag slides with initials and update version in the doc title.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: QBR Dry-run — Meridian — Thu 09:00 PT. Attendees: tara_cs, ben_csm, omar_solutions, lina_eng, elaine_exec, jordan_success.
ben_csm: ACTIONS:
- ben_csm: upload deck + version tag by Wed 5pm
- omar_solutions: populate renewal risk matrix + ask list by Wed EOD
- lina_eng: confirm p95 latency & hourly tokens by Tue EOD
- jordan_success: draft enablement slide + feedback themes by Wed noon
- elaine_exec: prepare exec-facing 3-bullet ask + cost delta by Wed noon
Any blockers?
tara_cs: None here. If deck ready early I can run a 30-min rehearsal Wed 4pm.
ben_csm: Will do. I'll ping when uploaded. :thumbsup:
